title: Should You Study The Solutions Or Solve Problems?
author: Scott Young
description: Watch the video of this essay. Learning requires effort. But not all effort is useful for learning. Consider the following situation. You have some problem sets for a class you’re taking. You have two ways you can study them: Which method would result in more general learning, letting you perform better on new types…
summary: But not all effort is useful for learning. You have some problem sets for a class you’re taking.
takeaways: This seems to go against what a lot of us were taught about how to study effectively: the only way to build skill is by solving hard problems.
You have two ways you can study them: You can solve the problems on your own.
You can look at the solutions given by your teacher.
